newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council urges employment-friendly social protection schemes.
newsitem.headline: Council urges employment-friendly social protection schemes.

text.p: The Social Affairs Council urged member states on Monday to gear their unemployment and other social protection schemes more toward creating jobs.
The Council said in a resolution that governments should take account of the need to avoid hindering employment through "excessive charges and taxes on labour" in financing their schemes.
It said they should also promote policies on benefits, taxes, contributions and wage deductions that give people a clear incentive to take and keep jobs.
They should also provide incentives for employers "to recruit employees from among the unemployed, in particular the long-term unemployed, young unemployed and unemployed women," it said.
The Council urged governments and the European Commission to exchange information and reflect on how to achieve those goals.
